top_signals.title: One AI Chipmaker Trade Blew Up $60 Million in Crypto Bets
top_signals.summary: The crypto industry learned an expensive lesson this week when a Korean chip manufacturer’s shares suddenly dropped.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Australia Core Prices Cooler Than Expected, Easing RBA Pressure
top_signals.summary: Australia’s core inflation came in cooler than anticipated last quarter, easing pressure on the Reserve Bank for a near-term policy adjustment and allowing it scope to keep assessing the economic outlook.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
